lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots extending from the mid-section toward the caudal peduncle, exhibiting a semi-staggered geometric arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like configuration along the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, marked by a sharp transition from high-intensity pixel values on the dorsal edge to low-intensity shadow values on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the trailing edge and base.
